question: Does a dominant spatially coherent bidirectional cycle component distinguish correct target transport more faithfully than global high-certainty purity in repetitive multi-door scenes?

predecessor.observed_boundary: All three transported extents had IoU 0.738-0.793 and all query SAM support bboxes had IoU 0.724-0.870, but DR03 global forward/reverse purity was 0.473/0.422 despite a 17624-pixel dominant cycle component with 0.00208 normalized mean affine residual.

Extent IoU remains >=0.5. No model, point, mask, component or threshold is recomputed.

lower the 0.01 opportunity, 0.5 majority or 0.5 extent IoU gates
